## 156db8fda1bb

**Reproduced override-contract defect.** `AXES["n_active_rows"]` advertises the exact valid range `1..h`, but `generate(seed=0, sample_index=0, n_active_rows=1, row_pattern="endpoints_only")` raises `ValueError: draw_int('n_active_rows'): override 1 outside [3, 6]`. No input grid exists for that advertised value because generation rejects it before sampling. Compact reproduction: `checks/audit/156db8fda1bb/case.json`.

The full override stage independently found the same class of range/band mismatch plus 14,718 additional displayed findings, 89,874 undeclared multi-axis rejections accepted only by legacy policy, and identical outputs for `intermediate_density=0.0` versus `0.7` in 69/90 same-seed sweeps. The linter also reports the missing canonical `RULE_HASH`. Evidence: `checks/audit-156-lint/` and `checks/audit-156-override/`.

Classification: **reproduced distribution/contract defect**, not a demonstrated Racket semantic error. I did not modify this audit target. I checked the generator source, documented axes, canonical task description/rule binding, lint, and exhaustive override evidence; I did not find or claim a hand-built input on which the row-fill authority returns an incorrect output.
